subject: Confirming platform for Thu demo — Meet link stripped when forwarded
content:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@nimtech.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:14 -0800
Subject: Quick: confirm demo platform for Thursday

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for booking time with us for Thursday 11/11 at 10:00am PT. Quick question before we lock the invite: when you originally created the calendar, did you add a Google Meet link? I noticed the forwarded invite we received seems to have the join button stripped (common when Outlook forwards a Meet invite). The calendar file attached to your forward (nimbus-demo.ics) looks intact but the meeting UI in a few mail clients won't show the button.

We can:
- Recreate and send a Zoom invite from our side (we'll include named guests if needed)
- Keep Google Meet (if your org prefers) and have our host dial in as backup

If you can confirm which you'd prefer and whether there are any guest/SSO restrictions (some companies block external guests for Zoom), we'll resend a clean calendar invite.

Attachment: nimbus-demo.ics (calendar stub)

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0126

---
From: Samantha Lee <samantha@nimtech.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:35:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: confirm demo platform for Thursday

Hi Michael,

Thanks — yes, I created the event in Google Calendar with Meet as the join option. I then forwarded the invite from my Outlook client to a couple of folks and it looks like Outlook removed the Meet join UI (we see only the text link in the body). I prefer keeping Meet because our LOB uses Google SSO, but if Zoom is easier for Redwood (and will reliably show a join button across clients) we can do that.

One caveat: one attendee (devops@nimbus.com) is in a secured tenant that blocks external Zoom guests unless they're added as named participants by the host. If we switch to Zoom, can your team add devops@nimbus.com as a named attendee? Otherwise we'll need to keep Meet and have your host provide a dial-in fallback.

Samantha Lee
Senior PM, NimbusTech
samantha@nimtech.com | +1 (617) 555-8872

---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@nimtech.com>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:50:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick: confirm demo platform for Thursday

Hi Samantha —

We can absolutely send a Zoom calendar invite and add devops@nimbus.com as a named participant. I'll:
1) Create a Zoom meeting (temporary meeting ID + passcode)
2) Send a fresh calendar invite from redwood.ai with the Zoom join button (zippered attach: nimbus-demo-temp-zoom-join.ics)
3) Add devops@nimbus.com as a required attendee on the Zoom registration/meeting settings so it won't be blocked by their tenant policy

One note on Meet forwarding: when Outlook forwards a Meet invite the iCal can end up with a stripped ORGANIZER or malformed X-MICROSOFT stuff that hides the button in some clients. If you prefer Meet long-term we can accept and add dial-in. For reliability across mixed clients we'll recommend Zoom for this demo.

I'll prepare the invite now — Samantha, can you confirm the attendee list (full emails) so I can add them as named guests? Ben — looping you in for the host handoff.

Attachment: nimbus-demo-temp-zoom-join.ics

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Technical Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
